title: Machine learning-guided inverse design of biomass-derived MgO nanoparticles with targeted sizes: A case study on As(III) adsorption.
summary: Produced MgO matches the target size category and shows measured adsorption above commercial MgO. SHAP associations do not establish causal synthesis rules.
organization: Liaoning Shihua University; Shenyang University of Technology
